subject: Pilot request: hosted API for case triage — nonprofit pricing ask
messages:
From: Elaine Walker <elaine@hopefoundation.org>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot inquiry: hosted API for case triage (nonprofit discount?)

Hi Priyom,

Hope you're well — I'm Elaine, Director of Programs at Hope Foundation. We're evaluating Redwood's hosted API to automate case triage (classifying inbound support/referrals) for a small national pilot focused on reducing manual screening time.

We have a constrained budget for the pilot (approx $1,200/month) but can commit to a 6-month program and provide a detailed case study and reference if outcomes are strong. Given our nonprofit status and public benefit mission, would Redwood consider a nonprofit pilot discount in the ~25% range on standard hosted API usage?

Key asks:
- 6-month pilot, up to ~200M tokens total
- Nonprofit pricing/discount and a cap on monthly overage charges
- Simple SOW and data handling assurances (SSO not required for pilot)

Attached is a short RFP and SOW summary. Happy to hop on a call if that helps.

Thanks,
Elaine Walker
Director of Programs
Hope Foundation
[Attachment: Hope_Pilot_RFP.pdf (pdf, 120KB)]

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Walker <elaine@hopefoundation.org>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot inquiry: hosted API for case triage (nonprofit discount?)

Hi Elaine — thanks for the note and the RFP. Priyom here (Account Exec). Happy to help get this moving.

Short answer: we do run nonprofit pilots but discounts above 20% require senior approval. Based on your ask and the commitment to a 6-month pilot + a reference case study, I think there's a strong case for an exception.

Ben / Marissa — can you weigh in with the commercial view? My recommendation: 25% off hosted API usage for the 6-month pilot, capped overage at $1,500/month, and a short SOW (no custom infra). Elaine — I can draft the pilot SOW and a mutual MOU that preserves Redwood's standard usage terms while giving Hope Foundation the pilot concession.

I'll attach a draft SOW and loop finance/legal if we need redlines. If you can confirm token volumes and whether you need any region/data residency commitments for the pilot, we'll finalize.

Next step: if internal OK, I can send a formal approval request to leadership for exec signoff (since it's >20%).

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com
[Attachment: Hope_Pilot_SOW.pdf (pdf, 45KB)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Pilot inquiry: hosted API for case triage (nonprofit discount?)

+1 on Priyom's take. Commercial notes:
- Estimated usage: 200M tokens total across 6 months ~= 33M tokens/month (peak month 50M).
- List pricing would be ~$6k/month at current rates; 25% concession brings pilot to ~$4.5k/month — below Elaine's stated budget, but we can cap at $1,500/month as a hardship option if leadership approves a deeper, time-limited concession.

I recommend the following structure for exec review:
1) 25% discount off hosted API list for 6 months OR 70% discount with a hard monthly cap of $1,500 (we prefer the first).
2) Pilot conditioned on case study + one joint webinar post-pilot.
3) No custom infra or on-prem requests during pilot.
4) Auto-revert to list pricing at end of pilot unless a renewal contract is executed.

Attaching a brief pricing workup for transparency. If leadership is comfortable with 25% (and we get a commitment to public reference), I think this is a low-risk strategic concession that can open more sector partnerships.

-ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: pricing_workup.xlsx (spreadsheet, 28KB)]

Marcus — forwarding for senior clearance.

Summary: Hope Foundation (nonprofit) requests a 6-month hosted API pilot. Internal recommend 25% off list for the pilot; alternative is a hard cap of $1,500/mo (deeper discount) if we want to make it budget-friendly. Pilot limited to hosted API, no infra changes. Marketing/BD would get a reference and case study.

Why ask: strategic nonprofit partner with a national footprint in social services; good PR and sector pull. Low operational risk for a 6-month pilot.

Attached is the legal redline we anticipate for the SOW (controls + data handling). If you can sign off with the conditions below, we'll issue the pilot SOW and get signatures:
- 25% discount for six months
- Pilot capped at 200M tokens total
- Case study + single joint webinar commitment
- Auto-revert to list pricing unless renewed

Requesting: "exec OK" or suggested modifications.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: legal_redline.docx (docx, 14KB)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot inquiry: hosted API for case triage — exec approval request (25%)

Marissa / team — thanks for the write-up. I appreciate the low-risk ask and the public benefit angle here. Approve 25% off hosted API list for a 6-month pilot under the following conditions:
1) Pilot SOW executed with standard data handling and limitation of liability language; no custom infra or dedicated capacity.
2) Hard usage cap at 250M tokens total across the pilot (gives a small buffer beyond ask).
3) Redwood receives written case study and permission for a single joint webinar; credit terms will reflect the concession.
4) Billing: pilot invoices issued monthly with the 25% discount visible; any overages above the 250M cap are billed at list rates and require prior approval.
5) This concession is one-time and does not set a precedent for other enterprise negotiations — Revenue Ops to log as an exception.

If those conditions look good to everyone, Priyom please document the approval and send the SOW+MOU to Hope Foundation for signature.

Marcus Lin
VP, Sales Strategy, Redwood Inference
